name: @authoryxos/openclaw-plugin
description: Delegate every secret fetch through AuthoryxOS: one API key per agent, intent strings on every fetch, human-in-the-loop approval with pause/resume.
author: AutumLabs

AUTHORYXOS_API_KEY.description: The one API key the agent carries. All other secrets are fetched through AuthoryxOS on demand.

AUTHORYXOS_BASE_URL.description: Override for self-hosted Authoryx-protocol backends (e.g. http://localhost:8787 for the mock backend).

tools.name: authoryxos_fetch_secret
tools.description: Fetch a named secret from AuthoryxOS. The 'intent' field MUST explain in plain language why the secret is needed — the owner reads it to approve or deny.
